goal: Prevent deadlocks and thread serialization caused by invoking kernel logging callbacks under an internal mutex
Align the libbitcoinkernel logging API with its underlying singleton logger to avoid misleading consumers
reviewability: Unaddressed reviewer objections are open design questions inviting feedback
agreement: Contested objection: prematurely limits the logging API and complicates future contextual logging (ryanofsky)
Unaddressed objection: a callback destroying its own connection hangs waiting for running calls (ryanofsky)
Suggestion to split out the lock-free deadlock fix into a separate PR (ryanofsky)
Support for single-connection simplification as pragmatic for consumers (sedited, w0xlt)

categories.name: kernel
why: P2 because it fixes deadlocks when consumer callbacks log or run garbage collection during logging
Prevents libbitcoinkernel users from assuming connections operate independently with isolated log levels
